WOODWORK — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Timber conversion and seasoning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber conversion and seasoning.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber conversion and seasoning.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber conversion and seasoning.

2. When learning Hand Tools and equipment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Hand Tools and equipment.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and equipment.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand Tools and equipment.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand Tools and equipment.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

4. When learning Overview of Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Woodwork.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Materials 2.1 Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Con.

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

8. When learning Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives 3.0 Timber processes and products 3.1 Preparation of Wood 3.2 Wood Wor.

9. When learning Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Growth of Timber Trees 2.2 Timber Conversion and Seasoning 2.3 Adhesives 3.0 Tim.

   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Adhesives.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Adhesives.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Adhesives.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Adhesives.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

12. When learning Growth of timber trees, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Growth of timber trees.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Growth of timber trees.
